sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Thakur Prasad Yadav,Vidya Dhar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Juned Alam,Mohd Hamid Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that initially a first information report came to be lodged under Sections 498A, 306 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.
However, Section 304B I.P.C. came to be added against the present applicant during investigation.
Accordingly, he prays that the instant application for bail may be dismissed as not pressed at this stage.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the above said prayer.
Accordingly, the instant application for bail is dismissed as not pressed at this stage.

Order Date :- 18.1.2023 Mahesh  Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P. on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46491195/
